purpose: Name-to-consumer candidate bindings for coordinated investigation; no rename is authorized.
coverage: Partial: explicit named-field literals and structured name/field values in selected consumer code and configuration. Tests are included. Batch-prefixed consumer identifiers are linked by suffix as candidates only. Shared spellings may refer to different native identities; every binding requires semantic review. Dynamic/reflection paths, computed names and absence searches remain unassessed. Each binding requires a structured reference (JSON pointer, named value field or declared value symbol) inside an eBUS consumer surface. Other protocol families (Modbus, EEBUS, CAN and Matter), generic test-case labels, transport metadata and bare spelling matches of a generic word do not qualify. Explicit eBUS catalog field pointers and declared schema fields may retain generic spellings. Names without a qualifying binding are listed as unbound; no absence is established.
publication_policy: Provenance is not published. Consumer locations describe references, not the origin of protocol declarations.
